scope: Requester disposition of an admitted chronology gap. Author timings and provenance are attributed to the signed statement; Planner did not inspect private session transcripts or rerun the large campaign.
changed_condition: The completed campaign may be retained with explicitly retrospective table/rules publication and verified pre-existing target attribution. The original before-timing condition is not claimed met.
unchanged: Five residual dimensions, complete data retention, existing targets/limits/authority, independent review and source delivery, assigned performer and main destination.
rerun_policy: No large rerun solely to replace missing pre-publication chronology. A new execution is still required if a substantive source/workload/evidence defect makes it necessary to support a claim.
